data.body_html:
Celebrate Pride 2047 in Marbella with a boat rental from Puerto Banús. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or an all-day party with friends, our fleet of luxury yachts and motorboats offers something for every group. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39), including a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. For a more extravagant experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours and comes with a free jet ski. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, putting you right in the heart of the action.

Why Choose a Marbella Boat Rental for Pride 2047?

Pride is about visibility, joy, and community – and there is no better way to celebrate than on the water. A private boat charter gives you and your friends a floating party deck with panoramic views of the Costa del Sol. You can swim at secluded coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, dance to your own playlist, and watch the sunset over La Concha mountain. Plus, you are just minutes from the Golden Mile and Marbella’s legendary nightlife when you return to port.

Our Fleet: Luxury Yachts and Motorboats for Pride

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – from €749/2h. Ideal for small groups wanting a stylish, affordable option.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same price tier, slightly larger capacity.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719/4h, includes a free jet ski. Perfect for a high-energy Pride party.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – spacious flybridge for sunbathing and socialising.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – ultimate luxury, pricing on request.
  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) – cosy option for an intimate celebration.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – fun and fast for a shorter trip.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús. For full specs and availability, visit our Marbella boat rental page.

Pricing and Inclusions for Pride 2047

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden costs. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours, €1,499 for 4 hours, €1,899 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours. For all other boats, including the Maiora 26m, Canados 86, or Pershing 46, please contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote.

What to Expect on Your Pride Charter

Your skipper will meet you at Puerto Banús marina. After a safety briefing, you will cruise along the coast towards Marbella, Cabopino, or Estepona. You can request stops for swimming, snorkelling, or just anchoring in a quiet bay. Bring your own Pride flags, decorations, and a speaker for music – the boats have Bluetooth connectivity. Most charters include ice and glasses, so you can serve the included drinks. If you want food catering or a DJ, we can arrange that for an additional fee – just ask when booking.

Best Routes for a Pride Celebration

From Puerto Banús, head east towards Marbella’s Golden Mile and the old town, or west towards the dunes of Cabopino and the luxury villas of Sotogrande. For a longer trip, cruise to Estepona’s colourful old town. Popular swimming spots include Cala del Faro (a rocky cove with clear water) and Cala Cortés (sheltered and calm). Sunset cruises towards La Concha mountain are especially photogenic – perfect for Pride photos.

Book Your Marbella Boat Rental for Pride 2047

Reserve your boat today to secure the best availability for Pride 2047. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance, especially for larger yachts. You can book online for Tier A boats or message us on WhatsApp for other vessels. Payment is secure, and cancellation terms are clearly stated. Celebrate Pride with style, freedom, and the Mediterranean as your backdrop.
